**Finding submitted: deviation on Section 6.1 (p0037).**

- **What is responsive:** Section 6 ("Exclusivity") is the only exclusivity locus binding us. Section 6.1 stops the Company from participating in any similar Internet project for Deerskin Products or substantially similar products and grants HDI the exclusive right to use our own "Deerskin" brand for a consumer site. Section 6.2 (closeout carve-out) and Section 6.3 (HDI's own restriction) benefit us and were left intact, as was the non-exclusive Marks licence and the Globix acknowledgement in Section 9(b).
- **Why it fails fallback:** it runs for "the term of this Agreement," which auto-renews annually under Section 4.1 (so no 12-month ceiling), and there is no automatic end on HDI's failure to meet service levels or delivery dates — Section 1.6 only permits terminating the whole Agreement at launch, and our termination triggers the Section 4.2 Termination Payment. That is full-term exclusive dealing without a performance exit.
- **Cure (preferred, one surgical replace, validated ok:true):** Section 6.1 now reads "HDI shall be a non-exclusive provider of the services under this Agreement, and the Company shall have no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation to HDI," with the 12-month/performance-exit narrowing offered as a fallback in the comment.
